obligation.exact_statement: For prototype B of D4 with fixed beta_1,beta_2>0, stationary p_theta(+1|a,b)=1/2+theta ab and |theta|<1/2, derive the actual finite-history operator q_N(y|x)=[sum_z exp(beta_1 ac+beta_2 bd)a_N(z,y)]/[sum_z exp(beta_1 ac+beta_2 bd)mu_N(z)] from a legal theta-independent causal circuit, explicitly charging all predecessor binding, Q/K/V, four-context frequency auxiliary, query/local residuals and length/type channels. Cover zero counts and declare exactly what the readout can observe. Prove the finite empirical Walsh-moment formula, show by a positive-probability legal finite history why the population interaction eigenvalue is not generally a finite-history eigenvalue, and prove the population limit and interaction gain tanh(beta_1)tanh(beta_2) using one joint edge-count event, including explicit dependence/mixing and finite-history TV bounds for the specified direct head. Give an actual finite-precision simplex family with explicit finite R=(L,W,H,D_qk,B_param,B_arith,score_range) and a theta-independent vanishing implementation schedule; known-score and exponential approximations and exact probability normalization are charged. Analyze the concrete affine/clipped calibration C_B(q)=clip_[0,1](1/2+(q-1/2)/g), g=tanh(beta_1)tanh(beta_2), with its coefficient precision paid: prove or identify a precise obstruction to per-fixed-theta max-context and actual terminal-query TV consistency on this D4 family. Any conditional terminal and average-risk claims must handle query/history dependence and correct weights. Clearly distinguish nominal algebra from finite computation, fixed networks from families, and this B uniform-family result from A full-context or D5 claims. Use admitted predecessor facts only by exact IDs and contents; this local result does not discharge the conjunctive root.
